THE TRIP

About the Kashmir Tour

This is a relaxed 5-day tour of the Kashmir Valley. You begin in Srinagar with the Mughal Gardens of Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh and the views of Dal Lake, then spend one day in the meadows of Gulmarg and another in the Sindh Valley at Sonmarg.

The last stretch takes you by road to Pahalgam, with stops at the Awantipora ruins and, in season, the saffron fields. You stay in deluxe rooms, travel in a private vehicle and finish with a drop at Srinagar Airport.

START & END
Srinagar Airport
STAY
4 nights, deluxe rooms
MEALS
Daily breakfast & dinner
TRANSPORT
Private vehicle
WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Dal Lake — scenic views and a free evening at the local market.

Mughal Gardens — Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh in Srinagar.

Gulmarg day trip — meadow walks, photography and snow activities (seasonal).

Gulmarg Gondola — an optional Phase 1 cable car ride, paid directly.

Sonmarg day trip — the Sindh Valley, snow-covered peaks and river views.

Thajiwas Glacier — an optional visit by pony or on foot.

Pahalgam — a leisure walk along the Lidder river and the local market.

Stops on the way — Awantipora ruins and the saffron fields (seasonal).

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Travel: Travel from Delhi to Srinagar Airport. Flights are booked by you and are not part of the package.
  • Tip: Share your flight details with us after booking, so our driver is ready to receive you at the airport.
  • Arrival: Arrive at Srinagar Airport. The driver meets you and transfers you to the hotel.
  • Check-in: Check in and freshen up.
  • Afternoon: Srinagar local sightseeing: the Mughal Gardens (Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh) and Dal Lake for scenic views.
  • Evening: Free for leisure, or shopping at the local market.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel in Srinagar.
  • Morning: Early breakfast at the hotel.
  • Drive: Drive to Gulmarg, about 2 hours.
  • Gulmarg: Meadow walks and photography, and snow activities (seasonal).
  • Gondola: Gondola cable car, Phase 1 (optional, paid directly).
  • Return: Evening return to Srinagar.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel in Srinagar.
  • Morning: Breakfast at the hotel.
  • Excursion: Full-day excursion to Sonmarg.
  • Sindh Valley: Visit the beautiful Sindh Valley.
  • Thajiwas Glacier: Visit Thajiwas Glacier by pony or on foot (optional).
  • Views: Enjoy snow-covered peaks and river views.
  • Return: Evening return to Srinagar.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel in Srinagar.
  • Morning: Breakfast and check-out from the Srinagar hotel.
  • Drive: Drive to Pahalgam, about 3 hours.
  • On the way: Stop at the Awantipora ruins and the saffron fields (seasonal).
  • Arrival: Arrive in Pahalgam and check in.
  • Evening: Free for a leisure walk along the Lidder river and a visit to the market.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel in Pahalgam.
  • Morning: Breakfast at the hotel.
  • Check-out: Check out from Pahalgam.
  • Drive: Drive back to Srinagar Airport. The drive takes about 3 hours, so choose your return flight time accordingly.
  • Trip ends: The tour ends with sweet memories of Kashmir.
